test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When the patient recovered, he was ______ from the hospital.
solution:
The correct answer is "**discharged**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
 
• **acquitted**: free (someone) from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty.
 
• **dismissed: **order or allow to leave; send away.
 
• **discharged: **allow (a patient) to leave the hospital because they are judged fit.
 
• **liberated: **(of a person) free from social conventions or traditional ideas, especially with regard to sexual roles.
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**discharged**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• The implied of the given sentence is that the patient was relieved from the hospital after his recovery.
 
• Discharged is a more common word in the context of the hospital so it is an appropriate word choice for the blank.

The complete sentence is: *When the patient recovered, he was **discharged**__ from the hospital.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**
